instance.candidate: x = 0 (no shared-ESS investment) at every active node (per the gate)

formulas.operation_part: sum_t sum_s omega_s (d_st - dbar_m(s)t)^2 (MW^2 h), computed directly
formulas.covariance: sum_t sum_m omega_m (pi_mt - pibar_t) dbar_mt (currency) = settlement deviation part at weight 1

formulas.non_monotone: sum_omega_d2(alpha_k) > sum_omega_d2(alpha_(k-1)) + agg_tol, consecutive tested alphas
